Velkar offers former commander Avelna a civil consultation role without military oath; acknowledges war and consolidates administration. Assigns Serakh/Rhazek/Orelia/Lethira follow-ups; Varkhess independently launches previously prepared limited naval scouting formation. No instantaneous communications.
Lucas/Miren discuss missing Talis, seven-note research, kiss and retire; system comments reward is hearing a people sing. Renshar victory news not yet received by Lucas.
